build_discrete_dqn_net: build a DiscreteDQNNetBuilder__Union with Dueling, FullyConnected, or FullyConnectedWithEmbedding network variants
build_continuous_actor_net: build a ContinuousActorNetBuilder__Union with FullyConnected, DirichletFullyConnected, or GaussianFullyConnected actor variants
build_synthetic_reward_net: build a SyntheticRewardNetBuilder__Union with SingleStep, NGram, Sequence, or Transformer reward network variants
build_categorical_dqn_net: build a CategoricalDQNNetBuilder__Union with the Categorical distributional Q-learning network variant
build_value_net: build a ValueNetBuilder__Union with FullyConnected or Seq2RewardNetBuilder value network variants
